name: Surfer-H-CLI
notes: Archived on GitHub, and the README marks it deprecated in favour of H Company's hosted Models API and Agent API and the hai-agents clients. The loop keeps the last three screenshots by default for the navigation step, which chooses click_element, write_element, scroll, go_back, refresh, wait, restart or answer; click and write targets are named elements that a localizer model (Holo1 or the structured Holo1.5 path) turns into viewport coordinates for Selenium ActionChains. Models are reached through OpenAI-compatible endpoints: H Company's hosted API, a local vLLM server, or a SageMaker deployment; one script uses GPT-4.1 as validator. A FastAPI agent_server.py and a Next.js frontend stream runs to a browser UI. Root LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause text with an H Company copyright, covering the repository code.
summary: Deprecated runner for H Company's Surfer-H web agent: a policy model reads recent Chrome screenshots, a Holo localizer returns click coordinates, Selenium acts, and an optional validator checks the answer.
